page.overview:
Who is Calard of Garamont?

Calard of Garamont was a famous and mighty Grail Knight of Bretonnia, as well as the Lord of Garamont, the Castellan of Bastonne and one of the Companions of Quenelles. He became a renowned hero of Bretonnia after saving the kingdom from an army of the Undead.

Born alongside his twin sister Anara into the noble House of Garamont, Calard's mother died when he was very young -- he was always told it was the result of a miscarriage -- whilst his sister was taken away by the Fay Enchantress at a young age. His father eventually remarried and had another son, Bertelis, who would become his favourite. Growing up, Calard always found his father to be cold and distant, and his stepmother bitter that he would inherit Castle Garamont over her own child.

The young Calard and his half-brother would often roam their father's land from one end to the other. It took almost a full day to ride from Castle Garamont to the eastern border and back, and as youngsters those lands had seemed impossibly vast and filled with adventure. The pair would often purposefully lose their chaperones, much to the distress of those bidden to see them safe, and embark on quests and crusades against imaginary foes. The boys rescued many fair damsels from the maws of monstrous beasts, and bested many evil knights in those childhood years.

By the time Calard and his brother had entered manhood, they were already skilled Knights Errant, having been trained since childhood by Gunthar, one of Bastonne's, and possibly even Bretonnia's, greatest swordsmen. Calard himself was a notably strong and powerfully-built warrior, his body honed through constant, near-obsessive levels of training. In the years that followed, both he and his brother would be forged anew through the trials of war and battle, often fighting alongside Reolus, a renowned and mighty Grail Knight.
